name: Question 14
problem:
Find the solution to the initial value problem

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)={x}_{1}(t)-{x}_{2}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=-2{x}_{1}(t)+2{x}_{2}(t)\end{aligned},\,x(1)=[\begin{aligned}-2{e}^{4} \\ {e}^{4}\end{aligned}].
$$

*Hint: The eigenvalues of the system's matrix are ${\lambda }_{1}=3$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=0.$*
